title: Customer Pilot Readiness: Anchor Accounts, Release Note Flow, and GTM Orchestration
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Coordinate cross-functional launch activities for the upcoming pilot cohort. Establish a repeatable flow for release notes that maps technical changes to customer-facing impact, finalize the list of anchor (pilot) accounts with tailored onboarding packages, and synchronize GTM assets (one-pagers, enablement deck, support runbook). The goal is to have 5 pilot customers live with monitored success criteria and a feedback loop producing actionable issues for the product/eng triage team.
acceptance_criteria: Five anchor pilot accounts confirmed and NDA + access provisioning completed
Release notes template validated and published to Drive with mapped customer impact tags
Sales and CS enablement session delivered and recording archived
Monitoring dashboard for pilot KPIs deployed and linked to alerts
Post-pilot feedback synthesis plan scheduled with owners and evaluation rubric
tasks: Finalize pilot account list and contact points (Owner: Marco)
Publish Pilot Release Notes Template and link to weekly cadence (Owner: Alyssa)
Coordinate with Eng to freeze API/SDK changes for pilot scope (Dependency: ENG-21807)
Design & distribute customer onboarding checklist and keys provisioning steps (Owner: Priya Patel)
Run 2 enablement sessions for Sales + CS and capture follow-up Qs (Owners: Marco, Leah)
Create monitoring dashboard (tokens, lat p50/p95, error rate, cost per 1k tokens) and set alert thresholds (Owner: SRE team)
Prepare escalation & rollback playbook for pilot incidents (Owner: Ops)
Collect and tag feedback in the central tracker and assign to triage queue (Owner: Alyssa)
timeline: Week 1: Finalize anchors + NDA. Week 2: Publish release notes template + sales enablement. Week 3: Provision access + run pilot onboarding. Week 4-6: Monitor KPIs, collect feedback, schedule synthesis. Week 7: Decision point - expand, iterate, or rollback.

rollout_plan: Staged rollout: start with 1 anchor account for first week (smoke tests + human-in-the-loop), then open to remaining anchors on day 8 pending no critical incidents. For each anchor, complete a 'go/no-go' checklist. If any anchor triggers a high-severity incident, pause onboarding and execute rollback playbook.
post_launch_metrics: Number of actionable product issues per anchor (target: <=3)
